description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::PreorderList class, which includes methods for generating preorder lists based on project purchase data, handling related database queries, and organizing data by days.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::PreorderList
classes.description: A class representing a list of preorders, with methods to generate preorder data from project purchase lists.

methods.name: from_project
methods.description: Creates preorder list data from a project object by retrieving its purchase lists.

methods.name: for_lists
methods.description: Generates organized preorder data from a set of purchase lists, grouping items by preorder date and purchase list.
